messages.author: b252ef2a9b7065ab
messages.subject: estimation of spatial autocorrelation
parts:
Hello,

I estimated a spatio-temporal model with random-effects, for both, space and time. For space, I used the spde approximation. Although I know how to compute the variance of the random-effect for the spacial component, I don't know how to estimate the spillover (i.e. the spacial autocorrelation coefficient).

Many thanks

Laia
